description: Defines client-side behavior for the 'Course Scheduling Tool' doctype in an ERPNext application, including setup of fetch hooks and a scheduling action button.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes fetch fields for the form, linking student group attributes to other fields.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Disables saving and sets up the primary action button to schedule courses, handling the asynchronous response to display created course schedules.
